messages:
Anita: quick thread: propose a tiny, versioned 'capability handshake' to shrink the hosting-adapter surface. goal is fewer ad-hoc translators and clearer fallbacks.

Sam: runtime likes smaller surface. optional fields and differing kvcache shapes cause most bugs. sample shape?

Anita: example (json/proto-lite):
```
handshake_v1: {
  capabilities: [
    {name: "kv_cache", ver: 1, optional: true},
    {name: "direct_gpu_pci", ver: 1, optional: false},
    {name: "streaming_chunks", ver: 1, optional: true}
  ],
  hints: {kms_mode: "proxy"} // hint only, no secrets
}
```

Diego: SRE needs metrics and circuits: handshake_latency, handshake_failures, fallback_rate, kvcache_hit_rate. auto-fallback if fallback_rate exceeds threshold for M minutes.

Becky: ops: feature-flag rollout: ff.runtime.capability_handshake = off|canary_infra|canary_customers|on. Canary script will flip infra subset then customer subset; rollback flips back.

Sam: compatibility notes:
- legacy dedicated nodes with nested kvcache -> translation required
- private/air-gapped sites drop probes sometimes
Plan: probe-first with exponential backoff, then assume conservative capabilities if probe never succeeds (avoid blocking traffic).

Anita: storage: small JSON blobs per node in controlplane, no DB migration. translation happens on read in proxy with a short TTL cache (5m).

Becky: add manifest-translation cache in proxy to avoid hot-path latency. eviction TTL ~5m.

Diego: tests: noisy-network DMZ emulation, long-tail latency injection, perf test ensuring handshake <2ms p50 on connection. alert on handshake_failure_rate >0.5%.

Sam: naming: runtime emits 'capability_offer', controlplane responds 'capability_confirm'. logs/traces use these exact names.

Anita: standardized missing-capability response: {error: "missing_capability", missing: ["direct_gpu_pci"], suggestion: "route_to_dedicated"}. SDKs can consume this.

Becky: ops checklist:
1) FF off -> enable on staging infra
2) run canary infra 48h with synthetic tests
3) enable 5% customer subset + SRE monitoring
4) stability window 24-72h -> increase to 100%
5) monitor incident delta for 90 days
Include owner, rollback playbook in PR.

Diego: KPI: reduce adapter-translation incidents by 60% within 90 days. dashboards and runbook required before GA.

Sam: runtime workitems: handshake stub, probe/backoff, diagnostic payload, translation shim w/ cache. WIP PR incoming.

Anita: platform workitems: controlplane blob storage, FF gates, routing rules honoring suggestion, translation cache.

Becky: ops: canary scripts, FF automation, customer list, runbook. i'll own the canary script.

deploy-bot: pipeline/runtime-handshake-pr #237 passed  (unit+integration)

Anita: action items recap: Anita: RFC + schema examples (Tue); Sam: runtime stub+tests; Becky: FF+canary script+cache notes; Diego: test matrix+dashboards+SLOs+runbook.

Sam: i'll tag owners and link PRs.

Becky: ping ops when RFC is ready; i'll assemble the tenant list.

Diego: LGTM from SRE if tests/dashboards exist.

Anita: thanks all. i'll post RFC in #architecture after edits.
